How adaptive control works
The demonstration estimates queued vehicles on each axis and assigns a green phase based on demand, bounded between 8 and 28 simulated seconds. Yellow and all-red clearance intervals are retained. This is a transparent rule-based controller, not a trained machine-learning model.
